python_interfaces.name: WorkingCopyRepository
python_interfaces.rule: static SQL/bound values only; repository never validates arbitrary draft schema, commits, or reads owning-domain private tables

python_interfaces.name: WorkingCopyContractRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: closed composition-root registry; each registered edit surface supplies exact schema and allowed dirty paths; runtime plugin/dynamic schema injection is forbidden

python_interfaces.name: UiRouteRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: closed compile-time route table; business IDs are encoded as route parameters and never used as executable module names

python_interfaces.name: ConfirmationTierRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: exact Beta 1.0 hold allowlist contains only infrastructure.device_reference.promote_new unless a later accepted owning contract adds another entry; default is never hold

python_interfaces.name: UiDomainRevisionReader
python_interfaces.rule: read-only freshness check for restore/conflict presentation; LLD-10 receives no owning-domain writer

python_interfaces.name: CommunicationPanelProjectionProvider
python_interfaces.rule: exact read-only workbench projection; LLD-10 may render/paginate it but never persists message body/count state or derives a competing summary

python_interfaces.name: DeliberateActionProofProvider

browser_handshake.auth_policy: LLD12_BROWSER_MUTATION_V1 = current-run session + exact Host + exact Origin + CSRF

python_interfaces.rule: LLD-10 owns continuous-input/visible-progress/cancel interaction only; server proof establishes minimum elapsed deliberate interaction but never business authorization

python_interfaces.name: UiSafeInverseProvider
python_interfaces.implemented_by: owning domain adapters on explicit opt-in only
python_interfaces.rule: provider has no generic rollback power; it may expose only an inverse/correction already authorized by its owning packet and must revalidate accepted current state on preview and execution

python_interfaces.name: UiSafeInverseRegistry
methods: resolve(owner_packet,inverse_kind) -> provider + exact owner command contract id | NOT_REGISTERED
python_interfaces.rule: closed compile-time registry; absence means Undo is unavailable and UI must show the owning domain's normal correction/cancellation/supersession/replacement/resend/restoration workflow instead

client_interfaces.name: UiStore
client_interfaces.rule: small surface-scoped stores implemented with standard React/useSyncExternalStore; server/domain truth is not duplicated as independently editable global state

client_interfaces.name: QueryController
client_interfaces.rule: only the newest matching sequence/filter fingerprint may replace options/results

cross_packet_rules: LLD-09 CommunicationPanelProjectionProvider is the sole Communication workbench projection; LLD-10 owns presentation only.
LLD-12 deliberate-action challenge/proof endpoints use mutation-grade anti-forgery and supply friction evidence only; owner commands still validate and consume proof where required.
Safe Undo is opt-in per exact owner inverse contract. No registered inverse means no accepted-state Undo button; no global rollback or UI-invented inverse exists.
LLD-10 owns only UI working-copy persistence and presentation state; all accepted operational mutation remains with the owner packet.
